summary: V50.z409 desktop-web responsive layout: partial pass. Desktop 1440x900: sidebar (testID desktop-sidebar) renders with all 6 items (home/contatti/chat/calendario/help/impostazioni + logout), PersistentBottomNav is absent, desktop-content wrapper is present (1200px centered), desktop-grid appears on Home & Settings hub. Mobile 390x844: no desktop-sidebar, no desktop-grid, bottom tab bar visible (native tabs bar), ThemePicker renders 4 cards in a row (~76px wide). Resize 1440→900 correctly hides the sidebar without crash. HOWEVER two critical desktop bugs found: (1) /calendario crashes on desktop with 'Errore modulo: agenda: isDesktop is not defined' — the calendar screen throws a ReferenceError (isDesktop used but not destructured/imported), so we CANNOT verify the 7-column month grid nor the FAB Axon-vs-sidebar overlap requirement; (2) horizontal overflow of 260px on ALL desktop pages (scrollWidth=1700 vs innerWidth=1440) caused by the EdgePanel shortcut drawer (testIDs edge-cat-crm, edge-a-home, edge-a-agenda...) still being rendered/positioned off the right edge on desktop — it should be hidden when the DesktopSidebar is active. Minor: Assistant FAB (AxonOS pill) at bottom-left visually overlaps the sidebar footer 'Test Owner' avatar/row on desktop; theme-apply button did not appear on desktop after tapping the Slate card (dirty state / rerender issue) while on mobile the same interaction correctly showed the highlighted card; testID theme-option-luce is not queryable via data-testid (React Native Web renders the active card without emitting the testID attr on the outer element).

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash on desktop: 'ReferenceError: isDesktop is not defined' → red Errore modulo screen replaces the calendar. Console shows the ReferenceError originating from expo-router entry bundle. Likely the file uses isDesktop without destructuring it from useResponsive() or importing useIsDesktop.

Horizontal overflow of 260px on desktop 1440x900 (scrollWidth=1700, innerWidth=1440) on Home, Contatti, Chat, Impostazioni, Help. The EdgePanel (edge-cat-crm, edge-a-home, edge-a-agenda, edge-a-new-contact, ...) sits from left=1440 to right=1700 — it should be hidden on isDesktop or when DesktopSidebar is present (in app/_layout.tsx StackWithCallBar the EdgePanel is rendered unconditionally when user && !inTour).

On desktop the round AxonOS FAB is positioned at ~x=240 bottom-left, which visually overlaps the DesktopSidebar footer row (user avatar 'T' + name). Needs to be shifted right of SIDEBAR_W (232) when isDesktop, or hidden.

After tapping a non-active theme card (Slate) on desktop, the 'Applica tema' button (testID theme-apply) never renders — the hint text stays. On mobile the same tap correctly shows the card as selected (blue border) but still no Apply button either. Possibly dirty state or selected update happens after ACTIVE_THEME_ID has been mutated, or the wideBody wrapper changes reconciliation. Blocks the acceptance criterion 'clicking a theme card updates preview and shows Applica tema button'.

The active card's outer Pressable does not expose data-testid="theme-option-luce" on Expo Web (querySelector returns 0). Only pearl/slate/midnight are queryable. Blocks automated testing of the active theme selection.

data-testid="persistent-bottom-nav" was not found even on mobile 390x844, though a bottom tab bar is visually present (native (tabs)/_layout Tabs bar with Home/Contatti/Chat/Calendario/Help/Profilo). The request explicitly asks that on mobile 'persistent-bottom-nav OR a native tab bar' be visible — native tab bar is visible so the acceptance passes, but the custom PersistentBottomNav component appears to not be mounted here (or lacks testID). Not blocking, informational.

integration_issues.issue: All sidebar tabs (home/contatti/chat/impostazioni/help) navigate correctly EXCEPT calendario which routes to /calendario but throws the isDesktop ReferenceError module crash.

issues: Persistent 260px horizontal scroll on the whole document due to EdgePanel
Sidebar 'Test Owner' avatar row visually covered/overlapped by Axon FAB bottom-left
Theme picker cards ~104px wide as required, 4 cards visible next to live preview — layout is correct. However the Apply button gating breaks the flow.

action_items: URGENT: In the /calendario screen (app/(tabs)/calendario.tsx or an agenda component it imports), destructure isDesktop: `const { isDesktop } = useResponsive();` before using it. The runtime error 'agenda: isDesktop is not defined' is thrown on mount and the module error boundary replaces the calendar UI. Blocks the entire desktop calendar acceptance test (7-column grid, FAB position).

URGENT: Hide EdgePanel on isDesktop (or when DesktopSidebar is visible). In app/_layout.tsx StackWithCallBar the EdgePanel is rendered unconditionally: `{user && !inTour ? <EdgePanel /> : null}` — change to `{user && !inTour && !isDesktop ? <EdgePanel /> : null}` to remove the 260px horizontal overflow on desktop.
Shift AssistantFAB (AxonOS) right of SIDEBAR_W (232 + margin) when isDesktop, or hide it (Assistant is already reachable from the sidebar/other affordances). Currently overlaps sidebar footer.

Fix ThemePicker: after tapping a non-active card, `dirty` must be true and the Apply button must render. Verify `selected` state actually updates (check reducer/effect that might reset it) and that the wideBody flex layout doesn't push the Apply button below the visible area. Reproducer: desktop 1440x900, /impostazioni → tap theme-option-slate → expected: theme-apply visible; actual: 'Tocca una card…' hint remains.

Ensure the active theme card exposes its testID on Web (theme-option-<active_id>). Currently only inactive cards are queryable via data-testid — this blocks automated verification of the active state.
Retest the calendar (7-column, cell height, FAB Axon-vs-sidebar) after the isDesktop ReferenceError is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx renders <EdgePanel/> for every logged-in non-tour route regardless of viewport — this contradicts the V50.z409 intent of a desktop-first sidebar layout and causes horizontal overflow.
The calendar page uses isDesktop without importing it — indicates the desktop refactor was applied without exercising the /calendario route.

ThemePicker uses `dirty = selected !== ACTIVE_THEME_ID` where ACTIVE_THEME_ID is an imported const. Confirm this const is not mutated by persistTheme() before Applica renders (would explain the invisible Apply button).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://business-card-pro-16.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend is remote (core.axonos.cloud) — do NOT hit local backend. Login flow: landing → click text 'ENTRA' → /login → auth-email-input + auth-password-input + auth-submit-button (test@dalpastro.it / Test1234!) → /tour → click 'Salta intro' → /home. Desktop breakpoint is >=1024px (see src/hooks/useResponsive.ts). DesktopSidebar testIDs: desktop-sidebar, desktop-tab-{home,contatti,chat,calendario,help,impostazioni}, desktop-sidebar-logout, desktop-content, desktop-grid. On mobile the native (tabs) bar is used (no persistent-bottom-nav testID present). After fixes, priority retests: /calendario on desktop, horizontal scroll (document.documentElement.scrollWidth should equal innerWidth), Apply theme button after tapping non-active card.
rca_of_issue: 1) Calendar crash: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/calendario.tsx (or a sub-component like AgendaScreen) references `isDesktop` as a free variable — likely a leftover from copy/paste refactor. Fix: destructure `const { isDesktop } = useResponsive();`. 2) Horizontal overflow: EdgePanel is a Samsung-style edge shortcut drawer that lives on the right side of the screen and expands into the viewport. On desktop the DesktopSidebar already exposes navigation, so EdgePanel is redundant AND its collapsed-state hit area (currently ~260px wide even 'closed') sits outside the 1440px viewport → scrollWidth=1700. Fix: gate EdgePanel behind `!isDesktop`.
